description: Stereo compressor with meters for input, gain reduction and output, and a side chain input that can drive the detector in place of the signal

params.text: Multiplies the input by 0 to 4 before the detector reads it, despite the tooltip calling it Fade In Speed
Multiplies the compressed signal by 0 to 8, and the result is clipped at 6V, despite the tooltip calling it Fade In Speed
Sets the level the signal has to pass before the gain is pulled down, 6V fully counter-clockwise falling to a hundredth of that fully clockwise, despite the tooltip calling it Fade In Speed
Sets how far the gain is pulled down past the threshold: 0 leaves it alone, 1 closes it completely, past 1 the gain passes through zero and the signal inverts, though its tooltip says Fade In Speed
Sets how long the gain takes to reach full reduction after the signal crosses the threshold, 0 to 500ms
Sets how long the gain takes to come back after the signal falls under the threshold, 0 to 2 seconds, despite the tooltip calling it Fade In Speed
Multiplies the side chain input by 0 to 1 before the detector reads it, despite the tooltip calling it Fade In Speed

inputs.text: The left channel in, summed across its polyphony channels
The right channel in, summed across its polyphony channels
A cable here makes the detector follow this signal instead of the left and right inputs, while the left and right carry the gain the detector calls for

outputs.text: The compressed left channel, clipped at 6V
The compressed right channel, clipped at 6V

notes: the Bypass switch passes the inputs straight to the outputs, skipping the input gain, the compressor and the output gain
a new module passes the signal through unchanged: Ratio comes up at 0, which leaves the gain alone, and Threshold at 6V
the side chain gain knob and the side chain input carry no lettering on the panel
